classification: No remaining static blocker to one reviewed local wiring run; not native validation, a product fix, or hosted dispatch authorization.

findings.proof: Unique app PID must contain comparison bQuantity focus at/before the before-marker and an event strictly after the returned Done marker. Another PID cannot supply coverage. Missing Done/hide remains diagnosable without absence inference.
execute and collect share invocation_succeeded, rejecting signal/interrupted/harnessError even when xcodebuild exit is0. The late post-zero cancellation mock passes.
Raw invocation status is retained on frozen-source/ownership refusal, with validationNotRun rather than an unsupported strict replay claim.

reviewedBoundaries.source: Only reviewed diagnostic instrumentation in three Swift/test files; original button geometry, focus write, typing, waits, assertions, selector and business checks remain.
reviewedBoundaries.capture: Bounded per-PID journals, independently collected live/persisted events, host-owned video and two decoded stills. Sink disagreement and missing markers fail capture; causalConclusion null and absenceInferenceAllowed false.
reviewedBoundaries.runtime: Explicit local expected build; retained inventory candidates and exact-build match; actual runtime build checked after boot and before build/test. A different actual build fails without substitution/retry.
reviewedBoundaries.lifecycle: One newly named owned simulator, identity checked before device actions. Only capture child objects are signaled; forced recording stop fails capture. Owned device shut down; no erase/delete.
reviewedBoundaries.outcome: Raw test, strict verifier and capture status stay separate. Failures cannot become passes through capture completeness. Refused validation remains explicitly uncomputed.
reviewedBoundaries.dispatch: Workflow dispatch is sole trigger; exact SHA and run attempt1 required. One original selector, parallel testingNO, timeouts720/900, no automatic retry or helper dispatch/push. Root owns the once-only manual-dispatch boundary.

requiredLocalWiringAcceptanceChecks: Commit and all11 overlay hashes match the reviewed patch; no acceptance-source changes.
Explicit runtime identifier/build; post-boot, pre-build and pre-test actual-build observations match. Retain any mismatch and stop.
Swift instrumentation compiles in original core Debug profile without fixture-condition override; compiled inventory contains original selector exactly once.

Opt-in reaches test runner and both original app launches; fixed tokens only; unique target PID bound to original before/after markers.

All three event sinks agree; both external PNGs validate; video ends normally and is separately inspected if used for visual claims. No inference from missing events without retained capture completeness.
Preserve raw test exit and strict verdict independently from capture status, including failures or cancellation. Mark incomplete evidence honestly; do not retry automatically.
Only owned capture children stop and only owned simulator shuts down; retain cleanup outcome.
limits: This review ran only Python synthetic mocks, shell syntax checks, parsing, hashing and scratch reconstruction. No native simulator/Xcode/test or hosted commands, Git mutation, or acceptance source changes.
Root separately reports commit161ab64 and its own actionlint checks; this report pins the immutable patch, not a native result for that commit.
Video is not machine-decoded by the harness; structural capture completeness does not establish touch delivery or a causal explanation.
Instrumentation and external recording can change scheduling. A pass is nonreproduction, not a product fix.
